name: TSDF Reconstruction from Depth Maps
aliases: TSDF Volume Integration and Mesh Extraction
definition: Converts per-surfel depth outputs into a unified 3D mesh by computing a robust depth value per pixel and fusing the resulting depth maps via TSDF.
summary: TSDF Reconstruction from Depth Maps integrates multi-view depth images into a Truncated Signed Distance Function volume to extract a 3D mesh, differing from neural rendering by using explicit geometric fusion.
